summary: Iter10 — Verified the P1 UI additions and the moved-out-of-dead-code admin delivery-pricing endpoints. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (admin/alerts schema, driver/cash-summary schema + driver-only authz, delivery-pricing-rules full CRUD, default-fee GET+POST round-trip, cash-handovers & payouts regression, customer cancel routes registered). Frontend: customer /orders renders 2 order-timeline cards with NOW indicator on the active step for both pending and completed orders; cancelled orders correctly omit the timeline. /driver renders driver-cash-summary card with cash-pending-total='SSP 0' (no pending cash for this driver), HANDED OVER TODAY=1, two existing assignments rendered, no error boundary. /admin renders 14 admin-tab-* buttons including admin-tab-delivery-pricing; alerts banner is correctly hidden because all alert counts are 0 (expected behavior, conditional rendering). Delivery Pricing tab renders 'Delivery Pricing Rules' heading, Add Rule button, Default Delivery Fee input (showing 2) — no crash. Seller dashboard Shops tab → Quick Edit modal opens cleanly, 'Delivery Pricing Controlled by Admin' notice with MapPin icon renders (P0 fix confirmed).

issues: Recurring React warning 'An empty string was passed to the src attribute' on /orders, /driver, /admin, /seller — defensive `src={img || undefined}` would silence it. Already flagged in iter8/iter9; no functional impact.

action_items: [INFO] No code changes needed — all 4 P1 UI improvements and the delivery-pricing endpoint move are functioning correctly.
[LOW / pre-existing] Silence the 'empty string in src attribute' console warning by guarding image src with `|| undefined`.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_alerts (cod.py:2020) correctly aggregates 5 distinct counts across seller_order_splits and restaurant_orders; returns ints; cancel_requested wiring matches the cancellations tab.
driver_cash_summary (cod.py:2073) merges marketplace splits + restaurant_orders, computes pending_total as a SUM (not COUNT), and exposes received_today_count using today_iso boundary — correct.

Delivery-pricing-rules CRUD is now correctly inside register_endpoints (cod.py:1942-2015) and reachable; previously dead code at module level. CREATE returns the new rule (with id), UPDATE returns updated doc, DELETE returns {ok:true}. _id is properly excluded via projection.
AdminDashboard.jsx polls /api/admin/alerts every 30s and only renders admin-alerts-banner when any count > 0 — verified: banner correctly hidden in test environment where all counts are 0.
OrderStatusTimeline is conditional on order kind/status — renders for active/completed orders, omitted for cancelled orders. Verified visually.
DriverDashboard DeliveryDetail no longer crashes — exchangeRate is destructured from useCart (cod.py-side test not exercised but page renders cleanly with no error boundary).
SellerDashboard MapPin import (line 11) verified by Quick Edit modal rendering the 'Delivery Pricing Controlled by Admin' notice with the icon — P0 fix confirmed end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the flows exercised (customer timeline, driver cash summary, admin tabs + delivery pricing tab, seller edit modal)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter10 items are passing. The driver duplicate-action accept/reject disabled-prop behavior wasn't directly clicked through because the seeded driver has no offered requests at the moment (only 1 assigned + 1 delivered). If a future iteration adds an offered order to driver@demo.com, verify request-accept-{id8} / request-reject-{id8} get disabled after a single click. Similarly the admin-alerts-banner is conditional on counts>0 — to exercise it, manually seed a record like a restaurant_order with status='cancel_requested' or a seller_order_split with cash_handover_status='pending', then reload /admin.
